import json
from ghidra.program.model.address import AddressSet

def dump(base, nentries):
    a = currentProgram.getAddressFactory().getAddress(base)
    mem = currentProgram.getMemory()
    out = []
    for i in range(nentries):
        b = a.add(i*4)
        try:
            v = mem.getInt(b)
        except Exception:
            break
        target = (int(base,16) + v) & 0xffffffffffffffff
        out.append({"i": i, "rel": v, "target_hex": "%x" % target})
    return out
print(json.dumps({"jt_404c": dump("142ae404c", 64), "jt_405c": dump("142ae405c", 64)}))
